Name: Gremory's Emblem
Basic Side: When two or more water units enter the exhaust after combat, gain a Rose Unit Token. It is a Tier I Unit that replaces one of your water Tier I Units. It gains the Attack and Defense of the removed unit. Replaced units are in the Exile Zone.
Condition: If all three Tier I Units that were removed to create Rose Token Units were Lorelei: Transform Gremory.
Ultimate Side: You Basic Ability is still active and usable. Instead of only applying to Tier I units, now all Tier Units can be replaced by Rose Units. Each Rose Unit in the Exhaust Zone adds to the total damage when damage is dealt to the enemy goalie. After a goal remove all Rose Units and return the previous Units that were traded in.
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.

Name: Zepar's Emblem
Basic Side: When your water Unit reveals itself, you can transform that Unit into a Swan creature type. Swan creature types get +1 Attack Power during Unit Combat.
Condition: If you have transformed 5 Lorelei units into Swans: Transform Zepar.
Ultimate Side: You Basic Ability is still active and usable. When a Swan Unit attacks an enemy Unit, transform it into a Swan Unit as well, it loses all other creature types during combat. Give the enemy unit -2 Power during combat.
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.

Name: Sallos's Emblem
Basic Side: When your water unit defends and wins combat get a Song counter and place it permanently on an enemy Unit.
Condition: If five lorelei have defended and gave Song Counters to enemy units: Transform Sallos.
Ultimate Side: You Basic Ability is still active and usable. When an enemy Unit that has been marked by a song, if it was marked a second time they lose -1 Defense Power. If it is the third time, it will deal damage equal to its Song counters to the enemy Major Demon (Max 3). Then it loses all marks. (Emblem to show to keep track on pen&paper)
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.
